notes.title: Untitled
Consignment system goes online.
notes.notes:
Game update:
    Consignment system goes online. Adventurers can trade with others now. We will keep improving it with subsequent updates and support more kinds of item and payment.

notes.title: We just implement new version of equipment stats system via hot fix today
notes.notes: We just implement new version of equipment stats system via hot fix today. The new version of equipment system makes the stats of the equipment more reasonable in each level range. We are confident that will enriches the player's choice on combination of equipment prefix. Also, we have adjusted some of the previously unused prefix to make them more practical. New system only works on equpiments obtained after the update. Previously generated equpiments will become Chinese with unchanged properties, which probably makes them collectable. New generated equipments will be in the same langurage with your clinet.

notes.title: Untitled
Maximal level will be raised to 100 at 9 pm. (GMT+8) April 24th.
notes.notes:
Many players have passed level 60 by effort. Congratulations!
Team PvP mode "tournament" will be unlocked when most of players reach level 100.

notes.title: Untitled
If your access is slow, please restart the game.
notes.notes: We have fixed several problems, hoping to improve the speed of game access. If it is still slow, please tell us at Steam forum.

notes.title: Some of our player links are unstable now, and we are repairing them.
notes.notes: This is a problem that can be repaired. Please wait a minute.

notes.title: We have solved the problem that the English client can not buy gems.
notes.notes: Now you can go shopping happily.XDDDD

notes.title: The server has been restored.
notes.notes: The server has been restored,now.

notes.title: The server will be offline for maintain.
notes.notes: The closed state will last for 15 minutes.

notes.title: We have added a group of European shunt servers.
notes.notes: I hope this server can help European and American players to link faster.Thank you for the support provided by YooooEX.

notes.title: The English translation of the player's skills has been online.
notes.notes: Now, the explanatory text of the player's skill has been translated. They have already worked.

notes.title: We have just pushed a new version to solve a few players' landing errors.
notes.notes: We have been waiting for a long time. Some of our days of restoration of BUG have also ruled out some obstacles to landing. Now some of the problems that are unknown should be solved. If you can't log on to the game before, please update it to the latest version. If you can't get in, you can get feedback from the community.

notes.title: 我们刚刚推送了一个新版本，用来解决少部分玩家登陆报错问题。
notes.notes:
如题。
大家久等了，我们这些天陆续的修复了部分BUG也排除了一些阻碍登陆的问题，现在一些未知报错的问题应该得到了解决。如果之前你不能登陆游戏，请更新到最新版本尝试。如果还是不能登陆可以到社区反馈。

notes.title: After creating the role, please restart the client
notes.notes:
It is now known that this is a BUG. Please restart your client after creating the role, otherwise it may affect the game.

If you can not login your steam ID, please replace your name in English and try again.

notes.notes: Let's go！

notes.title: This week we will mount an English test version.
notes.notes:
Is this a surprise?XD

But don't be happy early. This will be an incomplete version. It contains basic text and functional translation. The main flaw is the skill effect description. Because there are more than 400 skills, including more than 10000 Chinese characters. It takes a long time to translate. Translating from Chinese into English is a difficult process. As you know, Chinese is a very complicated language. Some words and even words have deep meaning. Some words have more than one meaning.So the full English version will be implemented in subsequent updates.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31149170/c427241627db720c7e7bcf069c6df1f24bd131fd.png[/img]

notes.title: Untitled
We are communicating with the Valve.
notes.notes:
Because Steam identified Idle Adventure as not an online game, so the audit process has been repeatedly continuing. Edel's adventure is indeed a multiplayer online game. We have been communicating with Valve, but once the audit is finished, we will immediately unlock all games to all players. We will try to complete this stage as soon as possible. Maybe this will be solved in next week's work day. We may delay a few more days. I'm sorry.

But we also have good news for everyone. That is, our translation work has made great progress. The translation of career and skill has been completed. Next, we will translate NPC and monster text. English versions are expected to be launched faster.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31149170/cf3556f40744fed8288d8340dc03bfe1471c912d.jpg[/img]
